results.content:
1. Live Assist (AI Meeting Assistant): This is Cluinn's flagship feature for real-time call intelligence. It opens automatically as a floating panel when a call is detected in supported apps (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams in browser, Slack Huddles, etc.). Users can type questions mid-call (e.g., "What was the Q3 figure?") and receive concise AI-generated answers based solely on the conversation transcript up to that point. The technology uses a local transcript (generated on-device where possible) and sends only the text of the question and relevant transcript snippets to a server for LLM processing to generate the answer. [...] Otter.ai / Fireflies.ai: These are cloud-first, cross-platform competitors. They typically join calls as a bot participant and record/transcribe to the cloud. Cluinn differentiates by being privacy-focused (local processing), native (no bot), and offering real-time Q&A during the call, not just after.
    Apple Dictation / macOS Built-in: macOS includes basic system-wide dictation. Cluinn differentiates with superior accuracy, automatic punctuation and cleanup of filler words, tone adaptation, and a dedicated interface for managing dictation. [...] www.cluinn.com

### Product Introduction

1. Definition: Cluinn is a native macOS application that functions as an AI-powered meeting assistant and real-time speech-to-text dictation tool. It operates as a system-level utility, not a browser extension or meeting participant.
2. Core Value Proposition: Cluinn exists to eliminate cognitive load and information loss during digital meetings and content creation. Its primary value is providing real-time AI answers during live calls and enabling high-accuracy, on-device AI dictation directly into any Mac application, all while maintaining strict user privacy.

### A bar that opens with the call

When a call starts in Zoom, Google Meet, Webex, GoTo Meeting, Whereby, Slack huddles, Discord or Microsoft Teams in the browser, the Calls bar opens on its own. Pick a preset and press Start.

### Answers during the call

Ask for the figure you missed and get it back while the call goes on.

### Cards that speak up unprompted

When a question goes unanswered, a Smart Card flags it and says how long ago it was asked.
